text: 「我想知宵夜食乜。」「咩？晚餐點算好 ? 」「唔係。晚餐係咩? 」我問佢。「哦你個屎忽。所有真正嘅戰士都食晚飯！」「嗯？我想知「晚餐」係咩意思。」「哦你 — — 」「夠喇！塞爾達，晚餐係乜嘢？」「你一定係講笑。」「屌你！加農，晚餐係乜嘢嚟㗎？」「你一定要先加入我。」「鬼唔係。安克利德公爵，晚餐係咩？」「哦唔該。」「路易吉媽媽，晚餐係乜嘢嚟㗎？」「好啦，好似佢哋喺布魯克林講嘅咁：早瞓，早捉蟲。定係，係百吉餅？」「咩？夠喇，晚餐係乜嘢嚟㗎？！」「好啦，好啦，有呢本字典。」「嗯 …… 晚餐 …… 乜嘢呀？晚餐係宵夜？」「係啊！」「你玩緊我？」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Pluvas!" I would say in Esperanto, but "Il pluve!" in Interlingua. Green and Blue: "It's raining!" In my lime green sack with an image of a green lizard on it, I brought two books to Tim Hortons café to read, one Esperanto, one Interlingua: Tra Lando de Indianoj, by Tibor Sekelj, and Contos in Interlingua, by Sven Frank. I was eating Scrambled Eggs with Sausage and Potatoes and drinking an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk. It was after 5 in the morning. The hall was practically empty. Outside the bay windows were wet streets. Today's the 17th of May of 2025.

text: 「普魯瓦斯！」我會用世界語講，但係「 Il pluve ! 」喺國際語言。綠同藍：「落緊雨！」 喺我個石灰綠色袋入面，袋上面有隻綠蜥蜴嘅圖像，我帶咗兩本書去 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳睇，一本係世界語，一本係國際語言：蒂博 · 塞克利嘅《印第安諾之蘭多》，同埋斯文 · 弗蘭克嘅《國際語言》嘅康托斯。我食緊炒蛋配香腸同薯仔，同埋飲緊一杯配燕麥奶嘅灰伯爵茶。嗰時係朝早五點之後。個大堂幾乎係空嘅。窗口出面係濕濕嘅街道。今日係2025年5月17號。

english.text: Contrast this with, say, Zeus in Greek mythology—powerful, but flawed and contingent—or the Judeo-Christian God, who’s absolute and uncreated. Extraterrestrials might land closer to Zeus than Yahweh: impressive, but not the bedrock of existence. Still, if they seeded life on Earth (a panspermia twist), some might argue they’re "creator gods" in a limited sense—though that’s more like being master gardeners than omnipotent deities.
